description:
Submission of details of refuse storage within the areas shown for this purpose on the approved plans pursuant to condition 5;  Demolition Logistics Plan pursuant to condition 6; Construction Logistics Plan pursuant to condition 7; demolition management plan and a construction management plan pursuant to condition 8; noise assessment pursuant to condition 9; sound insulation of the floor/ ceiling/ walls separating the commercial part(s) of the premises from dwellings pursuant to condition 10;  enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w and L'nT,w of at least 5dB above the Building Regulations value, for 
the floor/ceiling/wall structures separating different types of rooms/ uses in adjoining dwellings pursuant to condition 11; scheme for temporary solid timber hoarded fencing (minimum height 2.5 metres) around the perimeter of the site at ground level on all site boundaries and enclosure of the site from ground to third floor pursuant to condition 22; demolition phase (excluding installation of hoarding and Dust Deposition monitors around the perimeter of the site) of the development hereby permitted, details of an Air Quality Dust Management Plan (AQDMP) in accordance with the Councils AQDMP Template 'B' pursuant to condition 23; construction phase (excluding installation of hoarding and Dust Deposition monitors around the perimeter of the site) of the development hereby permitted, details of an Air Quality Dust Management Plan (AQDMP) in accordance with the Councils AQDMP Template 'D' pursuant to condition 24; Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) to be used pursuant to condition 25; Ventilation Strategy Report to mitigate the impact of existing poor air quality for the three self-contained dwellinghouses (Class C3) pursuant to condition 26 of planning permission ref: 2025/03016/FUL granted 11th  May 2026.
